title: John Lear admits he made up Dulce firefight story

tellings.quote: Leer said, "Oh yeah, I made that up." He actually said this,

plain: An author named Greg Bishop, speaking on Jesse Michels's podcast, tells of a well-known story about a firefight near Dulce, New Mexico, on a mesa called Archuleta Mesa. Bishop says that in the early 1990s John Lear, one of the men who had spread the story, told him plainly, "Oh yeah, I made that up." Bishop links this to a man named Paul Bennewitz. If true, it would mean one of the best-known tales of that era began as an invention.
